TutorialTour.Step1Desc: Launch the game and pick your desired Minecraft version here. Browse official releases, snapshots, or historical releases for quick installation.
TutorialTour.Step2Desc: Manage accounts here. Play with an offline username, connect custom skins via LittleSkin, or log in securely through official Microsoft auth.
TutorialTour.Step3Desc: Instantly opens the launcher's working directory (.ClMinecraft). Your mods, resource packs, shaders, worlds, and crash logs reside here.
TutorialTour.Step4Desc: Create independent instances for any mod loader (Forge, Fabric, NeoForge, Quilt). Each instance is isolated in its own folder to avoid mod conflicts.
TutorialTour.Step5Desc: Easily import existing modpacks in .mrpack or .zip format. The launcher automatically extracts and configures everything for immediate play.
TutorialTour.Step6Desc: Offers two installation modes: "Into Instance" filters compatible mod releases for your selected instance, while "Standalone" lists all game versions for manual management.
TutorialTour.Step7Desc: Check real-time player counts, ping, and status for curated servers and join in a single click.
TutorialTour.Step8Desc: Allocate RAM for the game (customizable per instance). You can also configure visual themes, acrylic glass effects, and automatic world backups.
TutorialTour.Step9Desc: Find documentation, latest announcements, and community support links. Enable log output in settings to inspect developer console or diagnose crashes with AI.
